༄/ /don nam mkha'i phyag rgya'i zab chos/ /na mo ratna gu ru/pra dzñā ka ra/'dir rje 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal 'bri gung pa'i gsung gis/spyir 'jig rta

tei:div.tei:p: don nam mkha'i phyag rgya'i zab chos// na mo ratna gu ru/ pra dzñā ka ra/ 'dir rje 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal 'bri gung pa'i gsung gis/ spyir 'jig rten mgon po'i chos nam mkha' ltar rgya che/ rgya mtsho ltar gting zab pa'i nang nas btus pa'i rdo rje tshig brgya lnga bcu ste/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig 'di yin/ 'di'i don ston par byed pa don snying nam mkha' phyag rgya zhes bya ba de ci lta bu yin zhe na/ de 'di 'dra ba yin zhes dpe gang gis kyang mtshon par mi nus te/ phyag rgya chen po nam mkha' mtshon du med// dpe yis mtshon na 'dus byas rkyang pa yin// zhes pa dang*/ nam mkha' 'di la dpe bya ru// nam mkha' 'di la dper ma btub// nam mkha' rig byar med kyi stong pa yin// sems nyid rig bcas stong pa yin// stong pa tsam du 'dra ba lags kyang*// 'dra ba mi 'dra khyad par che// zhes bya/ 'on kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis tshul lnga bcu pa nas dpe phyi rol yul gyi nam mkha'/ don sems nyid nang gi nam mkha' zhes bya ba dang*/ gsang ba las kyang*/ lar sangs rgyas chos rnams la/ dpe 'god ci snyed pa rnams de dag sangs rgyas mi 'tshams te/ de dag rgyas la bkur pa 'debs// 'di la dpe gcig yang dag ste// nam mkha'i khams gsum bstan pa lags// shes sam rgyas pas/ nam mkha'i dpe gcig /de la dang po 'jig rten gyi khams 'di med pa'i dus su/ nam mkha' stong pa yin pa la/ nam mkha' de la las kyi rlung gcig langs pa la rlung gi dkyil 'khor rgya gram chags/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'di brtan nas/ sprin gser gyi snying po can 'thug po las char babs pas chu'i dkyil 'khor chags/ chu de las kyi rlung gis bsgrog pas dwangs ma las ri rab byung*/ de'i 'og ma rnams la gser gyi ri bdun/ de'i 'og ma rnams la lcags ri nag po/ tha mar snying gas ma rnams la gling bcu ste/ sa rdo rnams su gyur/

de la rkyen gyi dbang gis nam mkha' la sprin byung/ sprin la char babs pas sa la 'bru dang sman dang rtsi shing dang*/ nags tshal dang*/ me tog dang*/ lo tog 'bras bu sna tshogs skyes pas/ de la sen mo ))))))))))))))))))))rnams yis ster 'tsho 'di byung gzhan yang dug dang*/ mi mthun pa'i rkyen sna tshogs pa las skyes pa'i seman mo rnams la gnod pa tsho yang byung*/ de nga na dus sems snying sprin pa dang bral ba'i ngang*/ sems gdod ma nas skye ba med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu dang po chos thams cad stong pa nyid na gi nam mkha' 'di la rnam par rtog pa'i rlung lhan gcig skyes pa'i ma rig pa byung*/ de la dra 'din gyi rtogs pa 'di byung*/ de la srid len gcig byung*/ sred len gyis 'us blangs pa'i/ nang du phung po lnga/ dbang po lnga byung pas/ phyi rol tu yul lnga la rig pa snang ba dkar dmar snogs khra cal gyis byung/ de la bag chags bzang ngan 'bring gsum snogs byung ste/ don de la dgongs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phags pa bsdud pa las/ mkha' la rlung brten de la chu yi phung po brten/ de la sa chen 'di brten de la 'gro ba 'di yang po gang brten/ sems can las la spyod pa'i rgyu ni de dra ste/ nam mkha' la gnas yin don 'di bsam par gyis/ rgyas mas/ rje btsun mgon po byams pas kyang*/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla mar/ ma dag pa'i khams kyis gnas skabs su 'gyur ba med pa'i mtshid la/ sa ni chu la chu rlung la/ rlung ni mkha' la bar tu gnas/ mkha' ni rlung dang chanyu dag dang*/ sa yi khams la gnas ma yin/ de ngan phung po khams dbang rnams/ las dang nyon mongs dag la gnas// las dang nyon mongs tshul ngan min// yid la byed pa dag tu gnas/ yid la byed pa dag tu gnas/ tshul ngan yin yid byed ni/ sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas/ sems kyi rin chen chos rnams ni/ thams cad la yang gnas pa med// sang dang badra ba phung po dang*/

skye mched khams rnams shes par bya/ chu khams dang 'dra lus can gyasi/ las dang nyon mongs shes bya ste// tshul ngan ma yin yid byed ste// rlung gi khams dang 'dra bar blta/ rang ni nam mkha'i khams ngan du/ de ngan can mi gnas pa med/ tshul ngan ma yin yid byed ni/ sems kyi rang ni nam mkha'i/ khams ltar rgyu med rkyen med de/ 'tshogs pa med cing skye ba med/ ces dang*/ 'jig dang gnas pa yod ma yin// zhes rgyas pa dang don mthun/ de ltar bag chanyags di rkyen bzang na 'bring gsum gyi sad par byed de/ rkyen ngan pa'i rkyen gyis ngan song gsum du bskyed pa yang 'byung*/ rkyen bzang po'i rkyen gyis dbang gis bde 'gror bskyed pa yang 'byung na/ de 'di las khams gsum gyi 'khorab 'di byung/ rkyen rnam par dag pa'i dbang gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal nas/ rgyun zhugs nas sangs rgyas man chad 'byung ba yang yod de/ de thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa yin/ mdoran bde skyed dug 'khor 'das mthon dman gyi snang ba snagos pa ci snyed pa thams cad la/ don snying po nam mkha'i phyag rgya 'dis ma thebs pa med pas/ rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba yin te/ phyag rgya chen po las ma 'das so/ dper na tung kun rgyal po dang*/ ma nyeg rgyal pos dkor mdzod na nor ci yod pa thams cad rgyas po de'i phyag rgyas ma theb pa med la/ phyag rgyas theb pa del gzhan gyi gnod pa byed mi nus pa ngan du/ nam mkha'i phyagargyas 'di 'khor 'das thams cad la ma theb pa med pa gcig gis kyang 'da' bar mi nus te/ chos thams cad kyi gshis dang babs yin pa'i phyir ro/ del ra 'am rus pa lta bu'i rgyas btab pa dang*/ rgya gzhan gyis btab bya gzhan la btab pa de sta bu ma yin pas/ gdod nas snang ba nyid sprod bral yin te/ 'di ltar kub snang ba 'di/ rig pas btag na 'ga'i rten/ ma rnyed pa nyid don ste/ ye shes nas gnas pa'i long spyod do/

ces pa'i don du yang snang bas 'khor ba yod na de las thar pa yod pas/ thar pa'i thabs theg pa gsum gyi lam bsgom pa la brten nas/ byang chub gsum thuob pa'i thar pa yang 'byung ngo/ de yang phyi rol gyi yul dris dang dol thams cad nam mkha'i rgyas thebs pa ngan du/ lus la yang nga phyag rgya chen po nos rgyas theb pas/ des nam mkha'i phyag rgya rgyas pa yin/ rgya 'di la phyi rol grub pa'i mtha' mi 'dra ba/ rtag chad du lta ba la rig pa phyin ci log du ma rnams kyis 'da' bar mi nus te/ spros bral yin pa'i phyir ro/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis mkhyane pa'i ye shes kyis kyang 'da' mar mi nus te/ dper na sa phyogs gar byin yang nam mkha' mi khyab pa med pas/ nam mkha' la 'jigs nas bros kyang nam mkha' las mi thar gnod sbyid gyi ri mo bzhin du garabros kyang nam mkha'i nyid las thar mi nus pa bzhin/ mtshams med pa'i las dang phyag rgya chen po tha dang du bya rje btsun gsang bdag gis kyang mi bskyod do/ de ltar shes bya thams cad la nam mkha' phyag rgya 'dis ma thebs pa med pa'i gnad kyis/ rgyu 'bras chu can gyi gzugs shar ba lta bu 'byung ba yang yin/ de yang nam mkha' rnam par dag pa 'di med na brag gam pha wo bzhin song na rgyu 'bras 'byung ba mi 'ong ste/ rgyu rlung langs pa yang mi 'byung ngo/ de bzhin du mtshid sprol ma yin na/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad mi 'byung ngo/ 'o na sprol yin pa la snobs su snang ba 'di ci yin snyam na/ 'khrod pa'i nang na lta mkhan bzhin gzugs snang ba cha nyu nyid las ma g.yos kyang snang ba dang 'dra'o/ zhes rgyas sam/ de la so so'i skye bo 'ga' zhig chu nang gi gzugs brtan dang*/ gzugs dngos 'dra mi 'dra bar yod snyam pa dang*/ dai dam tshe thog ma med pa nas khams gsum du 'khor zhing rgyas par mi ster ba'i 'dre 'gong po bdag 'dzin yin pas/ de 'dre de 'don pa la donasnying po nam mkha'i phyag rgya 'di bsgoms/

phyag na rdo rje'i phyag gi rdo rje yang*/ sting de rtogasapa 'i rdo rjes bdag 'dzin gyi mgo la rtag pa yin rgyas sam/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po las/ ji ltar bu mo gzhon nu'i rmi lam na/ bu mo byung zhing shi ba des mthong nas/ byung ba dga' zhing shib mi dga' ltar/ chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis/ zhes pa dang*/ zla ba chu'i nang du 'phos pa med/ ces pa dang*/ gzhan yang zla ba 'byin pa'i spre'u rnams dang*/ seng ge dang ri bong lta bu yin te/ rnam pa me nangagi gzugs brnyan lta bu dang*/ khyab pa chu nang gi zla ba lta bu dang*/ kha dog nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bu'i dpes/ chaus thams cad la gnas pa'i yul/ grub pa'i ngo bo/ shar ba thams cad sprol bzhin nyid kyi ngo bor ston te/ nam mkha' 'pho skyes ma byas pa'i don yin/ de ltar 'dir phyi rol gyi nam mkha' la dpe byas nas/ don nang gi sems nyid kyi nam mkha' bya ba gcig ston te/ nam mkha'i dkyil du bltas na stong par yod pa bzhin du sems nyid 'di cir yang grub pa med/ gnyis ka' grub pa med pas mtha' dbus med/ thog ma mtha' med/ dper na phyi rol gyi nam mkha' 'di la dbyar gyi sprin dang*/ khu rna la rig pa dang bral/ dgun gyi rlung dang bu yug ma langs pa'i dus ston ka'i nam mkha'i rnam par dag pa dngas pa de la/ dngos po dang*/ kha dog dang*/ dbyibs sam/ gzugs su grub pa med de/ 'gro 'ong gnas gsum spros grub pa med dam thams cad dang bral lo/ de nga na du rang gi sems rig rig tur tur po 'di yang khog la rig pa gzugs su grub pa med pas/ dang po gang nas kyang ma 'ongs la rig pa 'gro 'ong gnas gsum spros pa thams cad bral ba yin pa/ sangs rgyas pa'i dus su phyag rgya che ba'am bzang du ma song*/ 'jag mig srin bu 'am/ dmyal ba'i dus chung ba'am ngan du ma song bar skye 'gag gnas gsum spros pa thams cad bral bar khyar med do/

nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil na grub pa gcig 'dug na gzhan yang sred pa la grub pa med pas skye 'gag gnas gsum spros pa thams cad dang bral lo/ de bzhin du sems kyang grub pa med pas lus dang snang ba 'khor 'das skye 'gag gnas gsum spros pa thams cad dang bral ba yin/ de ltar sems kyi gnas lugs srol yin pa ltar lus snang ba yang nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu yin te/ mdor na sems can lus snang ba 'khor 'das thams cad spros pa dang bral lo/ gnyis pa lus kyi nam mkha' yang gzugs stong pa'o/ stong pa nyid gzugs so/ ces grub pa med pas/ stong pa nyid rgyu 'bras snogs su 'byung ba yin/ lung ma bstan la 'bras bu med/ 'bras bu'am rtags kyi rgyu khegs/ sesam nyid gcig du kun gyi sa bon ste/ ces pas sems kyi nam mkha' thams cad la thebs/ de rtogs pa'i dus su ri rab rnogs pa nyid pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa snogs pa nyid do/ ces pas tshul tu 'byung*/ de ltar nam mkha'i phyag rgya'i 'dus yin/ sangs rgyas pa'i dus na chos sku yin pas/ rtogs ma rtogs kyi khyad yin/ ris drug snogs ni bdag tu 'dzin pas snogs su 'byung ba yin/ des na 'khor 'das gcig kyi gshis sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen nas sems can gyi khams mos pa blo'i rim pa ltar khrid par mdzade da/ phyi rol nam mkha' ma yin te/ sems kyi nam mkha'i dbus gnas pa/ ces pa ltar/ dpe phyi rol gyi nam mkha'/ don nang sems nyid kyi nam mkha'/ des phyi snod kyi 'jig rten ci shing nags tshal 'bras bu mthon dman snogs su 'byung ba 'di dang*/ don nang du sems kyi phung po dang*/ khams dang skyed byed snogs kyi bsdus pa 'di dag kyang*/ de las de byung gi 'brel ba/ sems can rnams kyi las la byung ba/ las la skyes pa tha dad du bya bar mi nus/ gnyis pa chos pa'i dam chos dbyings sam/ de bzhin nyid kyis gnyis ka la khyab pas kphayang tha dad du dbyer de/

de yang go bde ba'i phyir phyogs gcig la mtshan mo nas/ phyi rolagyi nam mkha' 'dis ri thams cad dang*/ dngos po thams cad la khyab pa bzhin du/ nam mkha'i phyag rgya 'dis/ sems kyi lus thams cad/ ngag thams cad/ shes bya thams cad la ma khyab pa med pas/ de ltar nam mkha'i ra ni can nam mkha' nyuid las ma 'das pa bzhin du/ shes bya ci snyid thams cad la nam mkha'i phyag rgyas ma khyab pa med pas/ nam mkha'i ra ni can de 'di las ma 'das pa'o/ des na mya ngan las 'dasapa yang 'di'i gshis 'dug lugs shes pa la zer/ de bzhin gshegs pa rtag tu skye med chos/ chos rnams thams cad bde bar gshegs pa dang 'dra/ byis pa'i blo can mtshan mar 'dzin pa dag 'jig rten dag na medapa 'i chos la spyod/ ces pa dang*/ skye dang 'jigs grol chos 'di thams cad la/ nam mkha' 'dra bar gang rnams bsgom byed pa*/ de dag 'chi med rga med na ba med// ngan 'gro med cing mi bsdug phrad pa 'ang med/ ces pa dang*/ chos kun gcig par ni shes rab ste// mgo gcig tu ni stong pa nyid yin pas// de dag la ni tha dad gyu pa med// don gcig la ni shin tu bslab pa yin/ zhes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur tam/ ma byon na yang rnams kun tu// bsam mi khyab pa'i mtshan nyid 'di// 'phel 'grib yangs par gnas pa yin// zhes pa dang*/ 'das pa'i deng na nyid gang ma byon de bzhin nyid/ ces pa la sogs rig pa dang*/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ ces pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas pas/ chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid dam/ gshis sam babs kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa la/ sangs rgyas zhes zer de bzhin nyid rtogs pa zhes zer te gang tshe byang chub sems pa de bzhin nyid 'di rjes su rtogs/ de phyir de bzhin de zhes sangs rgyas mtshan gsol to/ zhes pa dang*/ rgyud las byang chub nam mkha'i mtshad nyid de dang*/ rtogs pa thams cad yang dag spongs/ gang gi de rtogs 'dod pa ni/

byang chub zhes brjod de/ zhes pas/ de bzhin nyid 'di ma nor du gyur pa la/ mya ngan 'das pa zhes sangs rgyas pa la/ der ma shes pas ma rig pa ma rig pa ma rig pas/ 'khrul pas 'khrul pa/ gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad bskyed/ gnyis 'dzin las bdag gzhan gnyis bdag gzhan gnyis las chags sdang/ de gnyis la brten nas snogs spyad pas/ 'khor ba 'di byung ste/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes/ bdag gzhan chags la 'dzin dang sdang*/ de gnyis dang ni 'brel pa las/ nyes pa thams cad 'byung ba yin// zhes pas/ de yang don rnamar yod pa ni ma yin yang/ med pa la med par ma shes pas 'khrul te mi bcir ba dang*/ tho yor dang*/ smig rgyu bzhin du phyin ci log snogs su 'khrul pas/ de spangs pa'i thabs bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas sam/ de'i tshul yang kun rdzob la brten nas don dam du 'gyur ba'i thabs sangs rgyas te/ don rnam ni bzhi ci lta ba bzhin/ nam mkha'i phyag rgya gzhi gnas lugs de yin/ de rtagos par byed pal kun rdzob rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel thabs mkhas pa 'di sangs rgyas ste/ kun rdzog la ni brten nas su/ don rnamams bden pa rtogs par 'gyur/ zhes pa dang*/ tha snyadalani ma brten par/ don rnams bde na par rtogs mi 'gyur/ dam pa'i don de ma rtogs na/ mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ zhes pa dang*/ yang dag kun rdzob rnams kyi sk+sa/ med par thar pa'i khang chen gyis/ steng du 'gro bar 'dod pa ni// mkhas la rung ba ma yin no/ zhes pa dang*/ mi'i chos lusags legs spyad na/ lha yul bsgrod pa thag mi ring*// lha dang mi yi them ska la/ 'dzegs na thar pa gzhan na 'dug/ ces pa dang*/ rje btsun chen po nas kyang*// rta khyus rta khyu 'byin pa dang*/ tri mas dri ma 'khru ba dang*/ bzang rtog kyis ni ngan rtog 'joms// zhes pa dang*/ rgyud las/ ji ltar skyes bu khrus mkhan dag dri mas dri mas 'khru bar byed/

de bzhin mi'i seng ge yang*/ rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog sel// zhes pas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad don nam mkha'i phyag rgya 'di rdzogs pa'i thabs su sangs rgyas sam/ rje btsun mi las/ don 'di nyid kyi gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum la dgongs nas/ phyi snang ba ji ltar lags kyang dang ma rtogs dus na 'khrul snang ste/ phyi yul gyi zhen pas 'chi bar byed/ rtogs pa rnams la sgyu mar snang*// yul snang ba yul lam gyi grogs su 'char/ mthar thug gi don la snang ba med// skye med chos skur dag go gsungs/ zhes tshig rkang bdun ma/ dang po gsum la 'khor ba ji ltar 'khrul pa'i gzhi spang bar bstan/ bar pa gnyis kyis yang dag gi kun rdzobs sam/ rtogs par byed pa' thabs lam bstan/ tshig rkyang 'og ma gnyis kyi mthug 'bras bu nam mkha'i phyag rgya 'di bstan pas/ bsdus na 'di gnyis pur yang 'dus rgyas par phye na sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad 'di nyid rtogs pa dang*/ sgrib pa spang pa'i thabs su gsung*/ 'di ni 'jig rten mgon po'i dgongs pa bla na med pa/ rgyal ba thams cad kyis dgongs pa dbyer med du gyur pa yin gsung*/ shubhaṃ// /
